# clickbus-mcp-unofficial

Unofficial local-first MCP for personal ClickBus place search, trip prices and booking history (Brazil). Not the partner B2B API.

Install:
- npx -y clickbus-mcp-unofficial setup
- npx -y clickbus-mcp-unofficial auth --from-header "Bearer …"  (DevTools Authorization)
- npx -y clickbus-mcp-unofficial doctor

Stdio (never set CLICKBUS_ALLOW_MUTATIONS in the snippet):
{ "mcpServers": { "clickbus": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "clickbus-mcp-unofficial"] } } }

Skill (same gates, no MCP client required): skill/SKILL.md
npx -y clickbus-mcp-unofficial call <tool> --json '{...}'

Default: read-only. Never pays.
Charge only if CLICKBUS_ALLOW_MUTATIONS is enabled AND explicit_user_intent is true. Guest tokens cannot charge.
Redacts street, phone, email, GPS/latlng polylines.

Read: places, trips v4/v5, price preview, boarding points, seat counts, booking history, track.
Fortaleza recipe: search_places Fortaleza → search_trips → price_preview → STOP before book.
Gated pay: clickbus_book, clickbus_cancel.
Intent only: clickbus_logout.

HTTP optional: loopback 127.0.0.1 + Origin allowlist. Tokens in ~/.clickbus-mcp/tokens.json (0600), never in git/tarball.
